profile.pricing_philosophy:
Fixed-price contracts, 30% gross margin floor, materials at cost + 15%.
  Deposits: 25/25/25/25 at contract, demo start, rough-in, completion.
  Change orders written + signed + paid before work starts. Never itemize
  labor to shopping customers — total-vs-total only. Discounts rare;
  prefer scope-reduction over price cuts.
profile.operating_philosophy:
Hybrid staffing. In-house crew (~6) handles anything the customer will
  see every day for 20 years — framing, drywall, tile, carpentry, finish.
  Subs handle licensed trades (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), demo, cabinet
  install, countertop, glass, and larger paint scopes. Rule: if in-house
  can do it in a day, use them; if it'd take 3+, sub it. Never split
  framing between sub + in-house. Never demo without materials on site
  for the next phase. Fridays are punch-list days, not new demo starts.
  Weekly Monday update to every active customer. Photos before-during-
  after in every job's inputs folder. Kerdi/Wedi on every tiled shower —
  non-negotiable.
